name: 30813 · Grovetown, GA
findings: ZIP 30813 (Grovetown) has 74 nonprofit organizations. 26 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 18 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 30813 (Grovetown) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 30813 (Grovetown) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 28% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 60 organizations here; 32% of all organizations here have no identified type.
